info.title: Moonkage API
info.description:
Hợp đồng hợp nhất của 7 service, sinh tự động từ OpenAPI của từng service.
Nguồn sự thật: `docs/architecture/api-db/` và mã nguồn backend.
KHÔNG sửa file này bằng tay — chạy `node scripts/generate-api-types.mjs`.

get.description: Owner or admin: profile, status, reason, canOperate (FR-27); the admin also sees the owner checks.

 owner-and-admin check above.

objectKey.description:
tempKey from POST /api/vendors/uploads, or, when resubmitting, the key of a current document
     of the same kind that stays as it is

SubmitVendorRequest.description: Vendor profile, used for the first submission (FR-26) and for resubmitting (AC-27.2). Fields with a format of their own (tax code, province, representative name and ID number, bank account number) are checked by their value objects; an error names the field. representativeIdNumber and bankAccountNumber are never logged: {@link com.moonkage.vendor.vendor.dto.request.SubmitVendorRequest#toString #toString()} leaves them out.

entityType.description: HOUSEHOLD_BUSINESS or SOLE_PROPRIETORSHIP; a company is refused with its own message (BR-33)

documents.description:
the first submission sends one of each kind the owner provides; a resubmission sends only the
     kinds it replaces, and every kind left out keeps the document the vendor has (AC-27.2)

OwnerCheckResponse.description:
Owner check of one submission (AC-26.8, AC-45.4): the owner's verified ID card at that time and how the declared
 representative compares with it. A MISMATCH name is shown to the admin as a warning.

VendorDetailResponse.description: A vendor profile as its owner and the admin see it (FR-27, AC-45.1). Personal numbers are masked only.

localDeliveryFee.description: null until the owner sets it (AC-28.3)

deliveryAreas.description: province codes the vendor delivers to at that fee (FR-28)

documents.description: the current document of each kind

ownerCheck.description: the owner check of the latest submission (AC-45.4); null unless the caller is an admin

VendorDocumentResponse.description: A document of a vendor; open it with GET /api/vendors/{vendorId}/documents/{id} (AC-27.6).

PriceTier.description: From fromQty pieces on, each costs unitPrice (AC-31.1).

SaveProductRequest.description:
A whole product, to create one (FR-29) or replace one (FR-30, FR-32, FR-33). Required fields are checked by the
 product's own rules, which name the field that fails.

version.description: the version read before editing; required to replace, ignored to create

resold.description: required when the vendor's supply source is BOTH; left out otherwise (AC-29.2)

brand.description: left out: the vendor's business name, unless resold (AC-29.4)

imageKeys.description: in display order: temp keys of new uploads, or keys the product already has

Image.description: key is what a replace sends back to keep the image; url shows it.

ProductResponse.description: A product as its Shop and the admins see it. Send version back to replace it.

SaveOrderProfileRequest.description:
Replaces the vendor's order profile (FR-35). Quantities and prices are checked by their value objects, the terms
 a supply source requires by the order terms; an error names the field.

priceTiers.description: reference tiers (AC-35.1), at least one, each starting at a different quantity

customTypes.description: the custom work offered, within BR-14

weeklyCapacity.description:
required when the vendor produces itself, with crustCodes, fillingCodes, packagingTypes and
     logoPrinting (AC-35.2)

crustCodes.description: codes of visible crusts of the catalogue (FR-54); one it already has stays even if hidden since

distributedBrands.description: required when the vendor resells, with gatherableQty (AC-35.3)

OrderProfileResponse.description: A vendor's order profile (FR-35); price tiers ordered by fromQty.

crustCodes.description: codes of the FR-54 catalogue in the admin's order; labels come from GET /api/cake-attributes

SaveDeliveryAreasRequest.description: Replaces the whole list of provinces the vendor delivers to (FR-28).

provinceCodes.description: at least one; each a province code of common-reference, e.g. "79"

amount.description: whole VND, more than 0; checked by Price, the error names this field

RegistrationFeeConfigResponse.description: The registration fee level in effect (AC-26.9, FR-53).

CreateVendorReviewRequest.description: An admin's decision on a pending profile (FR-45).

licenseChecked.description:
required to approve: unit name, code, representative name and ID number compared with the
     licence file (AC-45.5)

registryChecked.description:
required to approve a sole proprietorship: enterprise code looked up on the national
     business registration portal (AC-45.5, A-14)

RegistrationFeePaymentLinkResponse.description: A registration fee payment waiting to be paid (AC-27.4): open paymentUrl to pay on VNPay.

amount.description: whole VND, the level in effect when the payment was created (AC-53.3)

ProductImageUploadRequest.description:
Step 1 of a product image upload: what the client is about to send. The signed upload only accepts this type and
 at most sizeBytes; both are checked again when the product is saved.

PresignedUploadLinkResponse.description:
Before expiresAt, send a multipart/form-data POST to uploadUrl with every formFields entry as a field, then the
 file as the last field named "file". Then send tempKey as a document's objectKey when submitting the profile.

CreateVendorDocumentRequest.description: Admin attaches the registration fee invoice once the fee is paid (Q-36, AC-27.6).

kind.description: only FEE_INVOICE; the owner's documents come with the profile

DocumentUploadRequest.description:
Step 1 of a document upload: what the client is about to send. The signed upload only accepts this type and at
 most sizeBytes; both are checked again when the profile is submitted.

CreateCakeAttributeRequest.description: A new crust or filling (AC-54.1); the code and the position are given by the service.

label.description: the name shown to sellers and buyers, checked by CakeAttributeLabel

CakeAttributeResponse.description: One crust or filling of the catalogue (FR-54).

UpdateVendorRequest.description: Partial update; each caller sends only its own fields, anything else is refused (403).

localDeliveryFee.description: the owner: whole VND, 0 or more, per order delivered inside its areas (FR-28, AC-28.3)

UpdateProductRequest.description: A change of status: the Shop hides or shows its product (FR-34), an admin removes it with a reason (FR-46).

UpdateCakeAttributeRequest.description: Partial change of one value; a field left out stays as it is. The group and the code never change.

active.description: false hides the value, true shows it again (AC-54.4, AC-54.5)

VendorResponse.description: Vendor summary for its owner and the admins. Other services read {@link com.moonkage.vendor.vendor.VendorView com.moonkage.vendor.vendor.VendorView}.

entityType.description: HOUSEHOLD_BUSINESS or SOLE_PROPRIETORSHIP, so the admin list shows the kind of unit (BR-33)

registrationFeePaid.description: whether the registration fee came in, so the admin attaches its invoice only then (Q-36)

createdAt.description: when the profile was first submitted, so the admin list shows how long it has waited

VendorSummaryResponse.description:
What a buyer may read about a shop without being its owner (B-3.2).

Only the fields the public catalogue needs are here: the id, the display name, the head-office province, the review state, the selling flags and the provinces the shop delivers to. Nothing private crosses this boundary: no tax code, no address, no representative, no bank account, no document and no admin note (NFR-03).

provinceCode.description: the head-office province of the shop; null only for a copy written before the field existed

canOperate.description: approved and registration fee paid (BR-20, BR-31)

deliveryAreas.description: province codes the shop delivers to (FR-28)

RegistrationFeePaymentResponse.description: The registration fee the vendor paid (BR-31, AC-53.2): at most one per vendor.

VendorDocumentLinkResponse.description: Short-lived link to a document in the private bucket (AC-27.6).
